description: Header file defining the `em_cli_t` class, which provides command-line interface (CLI) functionalities for network command processing, including command retrieval, execution, address setting, and debugging support within a network management context.

classes.name: em_cli_t
classes.description: A class encapsulating the command-line interface for network management, providing methods for command retrieval, execution, address configuration, and debugging.

methods.name: get_command
methods.description: Retrieves the command object based on input string, length, and optional network node.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a command string on the specified network node.

methods.name: set_remote_addr
methods.description: Sets the remote IP address and port, and marks the address as valid.

methods.name: is_remote_addr_valid
methods.description: Checks if the remote address has been marked as valid.

methods.name: get_first_cmd_str
methods.description: Returns the first command string for CLI iteration.

methods.name: get_next_cmd_str
methods.description: Returns the next command string following the given command.

methods.name: get_reset_tree
methods.description: Retrieves the reset tree for a specific platform.

methods.name: init_lib_dbg
methods.description: Initializes debugging by specifying a debug log file.

methods.name: dump_lib_dbg
methods.description: Dumps debugging information contained within the provided string.

methods.name: em_cli_t
methods.description: Constructor for creating an instance of the command-line interface class.

methods.name: ~em_cli_t
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources used by the CLI object.
